Prearranged editable demonstration. It is not the output of an automatic scene reconstruction.

Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HERO_-_Blender_Open_Movie-full_movie.webm. Excerpts near 00:32–00:40 and 01:12–01:20; resized, re-encoded and audio removed. Evidence thumbnails are derived from these excerpts.

Finite planes and closed volume candidates use original-image boundaries, SAM region proposals, conditional vanishing directions and depth-ordering priors. Ground, unseen heights and camera calibration remain conditional/inferred. Depth sheets remain comparison alternatives. These are qualitative development examples, not validated anime reconstruction.

The public scenery fixture omits dynamic bbox proposals to bound browser storage; native jobs retain them. These omitted observations do not support structural geometry. Sparse model anchors and image warps do not establish 3D camera travel.

Experimental incomplete scene reconstruction. Region meshes follow visible silhouettes and a relative-depth proposal; unseen sides and backs are inferred closures, not recovered architecture. Source texture adds appearance, not geometric evidence. No full-scene or anime accuracy claim is made.
The hosted fixture keeps one structural hypothesis per fragment to bound browser storage. Native processing retains alternative hidden-thickness hypotheses. Source observations remain unchanged.

HERO / still study uses the first frame of the courtyard excerpt as a separate image source. It is repeated evidence, not a new viewpoint. Its depth surface and proposed location link do not provide independent temporal evidence or measured geometric alignment.

Hosted storage retains every referenced source feature and one depth-sheet comparison per clip or still. Unreferenced feature proposals and repeated comparison meshes are omitted; native jobs retain them.

The architectural study automatically fits ONE rounded structure in the existing courtyard still. Its roof/opening association uses original-image edges and a conditional camera. Recession, footprint and hidden surfaces remain inferred. The rest of the city is not reconstructed. Other clip scenes retain the earlier prototype for comparison; this is the same source frame, not a new independent view.
